title: Descartes Christmas Colloquium: The Scientific Party
description: The Descartes Centre's yearly Christmas colloquium: 7-8 minute talks by students and staff on the theme "the Scientific Party" (from graduation ceremonies and science fairs to student life and conference socials), followed by drinks and snacks from 17:00 to 19:00. Want to give a talk? E-mail your idea to dc-colloquium@uu.nl by 20 November.
